estimand_register.outcome: decolorization of dye from synthetic textile wastewater

metric.name: decolorization_efficiency
metric.definition: percentage reduction in baseline-corrected UV-vis absorbance at the dye peak

evidence.quote: In a batch test at room temperature, synthetic textile wastewater containing Reactive Red 195 received UV/H2O2 treatment; after a 90 min observation horizon with a 90 min exposure budget, the decolorization efficiency, defined as the percentage reduction in baseline-corrected UV-vis absorbance at the dye peak, was 92%.

estimand_register.outcome: removal of dye from aqueous solution

metric.name: adsorption_removal_fraction
metric.definition: percentage reduction in measured aqueous Methylene Blue concentration from initial concentration

evidence.quote: In a batch test at room temperature, synthetic aqueous dye solution containing Methylene Blue contacted activated carbon; at a fixed 90 min observation horizon, the adsorption removal fraction, defined as the percentage reduction in measured aqueous Methylene Blue concentration from initial concentration, was 92%.
The adsorbent-mass budget was not reported; a decrease in aqueous dye concentration was the qualitative direction.
